title: When You're Outnumbered
speaker: Pastor Demo
bigIdea: Fear counts the enemy. Faith counts what God has around you.
challenge: Every time you feel outnumbered this week, pray Elisha's prayer for someone else: "LORD, open his eyes."
discussion: When have you felt surrounded with no way out?
Elisha's servant saw the army first. What do you tend to see first?
Who in your life needs their eyes opened this week?

questions.q: Who kept warning the king of Israel about Syria's plans?
What surrounded the city of Dothan in the morning?
options: An army with horses and chariots

questions.q: "Fear not: for they that be with us are more than they that be with them."
When the servant's eyes were opened, what did he see on the mountain?
